name: Write And Publish Book
description: End-to-end guided journey from initial concept through novel planning, character development, outlining, developmental editing, line editing, publishing, and marketing. Covers both fiction and nonfiction paths with decision gates for self-publishing versus traditional publishing. Use when the user wants to write and publish book or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
